def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize sex label variants (extra spaces)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('object').str.strip()
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix out-of-range body mass: 5050000 g is a unit/typo error for 5050 g
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    g = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
